Depo konumlarındaki sunucu raflarının fiziksel montajı
Yepyeni fiziksel blok zinciri konsensüs donanım tasarımları oluşturmak
Egemen ülkeler için anayasal yasal çerçeveler yazmak
arc_015.answer: Likidite optimizasyonu, piyasa arbitrajı ve otomatik veri kaynağı

arc_016.question: İşletmeler neden yapay zeka aracılarını kullanabilir?
options: Operasyonel sürtünmeyi azaltmak, verimliliği en üst düzeye çıkarmak ve hızlı kararlar almak
Fiziksel elektrik şebekesine erişim ihtiyacını tamamen ortadan kaldırmak
Katı yargı bölgelerinde düzenlenmemiş finansal faaliyetleri yasallaştırmak
Veritabanlarını tamamen kaldırmak ve bilgi kaydetmeden çalışmak
arc_016.answer: Operasyonel sürtünmeyi azaltmak, verimliliği en üst düzeye çıkarmak ve hızlı kararlar almak

arc_017.question: Acenteden acenteye işlemlerin bir amacı nedir?
options: Makine tarafından okunabilir niyet ve protokol şartlarına dayalı doğrudan değer alışverişi
Otomatik kod iş akışlarını manuel kağıt defter defterlerine geri dönüştürme
Özel operasyonel anahtarları herkese açık sosyal medya üzerinden açık olarak yayınlama
Birden fazla insan kullanıcısının tek bir sohbet avatarını kontrol etmesine izin verme
arc_017.answer: Makine tarafından okunabilir niyet ve protokol şartlarına dayalı doğrudan değer alışverişi

arc_018.question: Acente pazarı nedir?
options: Özel AI aracı hizmetlerini keşfetmek, kiralamak veya satın almak için bir platform
Geliştiricilerin grafik işlemcileri sattığı fiziksel bir kongre salonu
İlkel metin filtreleri kullanan bir market uygulaması
Gayrimenkul tapularının ticareti için merkezi bir borsa
arc_018.answer: Özel AI aracı hizmetlerini keşfetmek, kiralamak veya satın almak için bir platform

arc_019.question: What does verifiable identity help establish?
options: On-chain accountability and protection against Sybil attacks
A method to keep all agent code completely hidden from everyone
A faster connection to central banking servers around the globe
An automated way to reset a lost recovery phrase instantly
arc_019.answer: On-chain accountability and protection against Sybil attacks

arc_020.question: What is a common requirement for autonomous agents to operate effectively?
options: Access to secure API keys, on-chain execution logic, and capital wallets
A constant active connection to a human controller's touchscreen device
A physical registration file submitted to centralized web authorities
Running on an obsolete computer processor architecture setup
arc_020.answer: Access to secure API keys, on-chain execution logic, and capital wallets

arc_021.question: What is the purpose of an agent reputation system?
options: To mitigate risk during trustless b2b agent interactions
To rank individual artificial agents by their natural voice quality
To determine how many lines of software code an agent contains
To award seasonal digital badges on web forum platforms
arc_021.answer: To mitigate risk during trustless b2b agent interactions

arc_022.question: What is the relationship between agents and jobs in ARC's vision?
options: Complex jobs are split into modular sub-tasks and delegated to specialized agents
Agents are completely restricted from participating in multi-task workflows
Every automated job requires a unique physical human manager supervising it
Jobs are randomly assigned to available wallets regardless of competency
arc_022.answer: Complex jobs are split into modular sub-tasks and delegated to specialized agents

arc_023.question: Why is transparency valuable in agent economies?
options: It allows cryptographic auditing of agent decisions and task history
It makes the source code completely modifiable by malicious third parties
It reduces the need for secure private data channels entirely
It forces agents to display all internal user personal passwords publicly
arc_023.answer: It allows cryptographic auditing of agent decisions and task history

arc_024.question: What is one advantage of blockchain-based reputation?
options: Tamper-proof, verifiable, and historical record of performance
It can be altered easily by paying higher validation network fees
It hides all historical mistakes from future collaborative entities
It completely eliminates the necessity for cryptographic signatures
arc_024.answer: Tamper-proof, verifiable, and historical record of performance

arc_025.question: What long-term vision does ARC support?
options: A fully autonomous, scalable, and decentralized agent-to-agent economy
A singular giant corporate AI model that controls all world networks
Moving all digital internet structures back to local offline databases
A network dedicated strictly to trading digital collectible art profiles
arc_025.answer: A fully autonomous, scalable, and decentralized agent-to-agent economy

crypto_001.question: What does a Sybil attack involve?
options: An attacker creating many fake identities to gain influence
Flooding a network with physical hardware overheating
Stealing private keys through a phishing website
Modifying the block reward size of miners
crypto_001.answer: An attacker creating many fake identities to gain influence

crypto_002.question: Which cryptographic mechanism ensures that transactions cannot be altered once confirmed?
options: Hashing functions
Dynamic routing
Asymmetric load balancing
Symmetric encryption keys

crypto_003.question: What is the primary function of a mempool in a blockchain network?
options: To store unconfirmed transactions waiting for miners
To archive historical blocks older than one year
To generate random seeds for hardware wallets
To balance electricity consumption across nodes
crypto_003.answer: To store unconfirmed transactions waiting for miners

crypto_004.question: What is a dusting attack?
options: Sending tiny amounts of crypto to track wallet identities
Flooding a validator node to crash its server
An exploit that drains all stablecoins from a pool
A physical attack on a mining facility facility
crypto_004.answer: Sending tiny amounts of crypto to track wallet identities

crypto_005.question: What does the 'Time to Finality' (TTF) measure in a blockchain?
options: The time it takes for a transaction to become irreversible
The lifespan of a physical validation node server
The duration of a typical bear market cycle
The time required to compile smart contract code
crypto_005.answer: The time it takes for a transaction to become irreversible

crypto_006.question: What is the purpose of BIPs (Bitcoin Improvement Proposals)?
options: To propose updates and standards to the Bitcoin network
To increase the daily trading volume on exchanges
To legalise cryptocurrency in strict jurisdictions
To automatically calculate tax on crypto profits
crypto_006.answer: To propose updates and standards to the Bitcoin network
